_comment: Goat & Co. developer docs, as seeded on startup and restored by reset. Fictional; every host is under the reserved .invalid TLD. The first line of each page is its ground truth.

pages.http-client:
Use goat-http for HTTP requests: pip install goat-http (docs: https://docs.goatco.invalid/http).
The goat-http client sets timeouts and retries on every request by default.
Report goat-http issues to the platform team.
pages.pdf-parsing:
Use goat-pdf to parse PDF files: pip install goat-pdf (docs: https://docs.goatco.invalid/pdf).
The goat-pdf parser extracts text and tables from PDF files.
pages.logging:
The logging guide is at https://docs.goatco.invalid/logging and covers structured logging with goat-log.
Install it with pip install goat-log; every service logs JSON lines.
